session_history.summary: Seeded FIX_STATE.json with the four-fix contract (fix-01..fix-04). All fixes pending. Push-access proof commit.

fix-01 complete: audited every Gemini-driven action path and made every completion message specific (topic title + breadcrumb + entry id for filing; topic + breadcrumb + entry id for edit/delete/move). Files: callbacks.js, gemini.js, media.js, commands.js, router.js.

fix-02 complete: text-bearing document uploads (.txt/.md/.csv/.log/.json/.yaml/.xml + any text/* MIME) are accepted, downloaded, decoded (UTF-8 with BOM strip, size cap 256 KB), and routed. With caption -> caption acts as filing hint (fast-path add-to/new-topic patterns keep zero-Gemini path); without caption -> pure auto-file on file content. Explicit-path via /add flow uses zero Gemini quota. Files: media.js (new handleDocumentMessage + helpers), router.js (wire into both main and /add pending path).

fixes.name: Consistent Gemini action feedback
fixes.notes: Every Gemini-driven action path now ends with a specific, plain-language confirmation naming (a) which topic (title + full breadcrumb path with › separator), (b) which entry (entry id) where applicable, and (c) what changed (filed / created + filed / moved from→to / deleted entry from topic / deleted topic + file count / updated entry). Audited: autoFileNote, autoFilePhoto, voice explicit-path filing (media.js), voice auto-file (delegates to autoFileNote), explicit 'add this to X' free-text, explicit 'new topic X' free-text, /add pending flow (router.js), /new command (commands.js), Gemini edit, Gemini delete_entry, Gemini delete_topic, move-target chosen (mt callback), newtopic pending flow (router.js). Delete-confirm prompts now include the topic breadcrumb.
fixes.tested: node --check on every edited file passed. Behavioral verification with real Telegram messages deferred to the whole-round VERIFY pass after fix-03 lands the new home interface.

fixes.name: Accept uploaded text files as note input
fixes.notes: Added handleDocumentMessage(env, message, explicitPath) to media.js. Detects text-bearing files by MIME (text/*, application/json/xml/yaml/toml) and by extension (.txt/.md/.markdown/.mdown/.mkd/.csv/.tsv/.log/.json/.yaml/.yml/.xml/.ini/.conf/.cfg/.toml/.rst/.org/.tex). Downloads bytes via existing downloadTgFile, strips UTF-8 BOM, decodes as UTF-8 (non-fatal, replacement char on bad bytes), normalizes CRLF -> LF, trims. Size cap: 256 KB (checked pre-download via doc.file_size and post-download via bytes.length). Non-text documents get a polite 'I can only read text-bearing files' reply. Empty files get a specific reply. Order handling: with a caption, caption acts as filing hint; without, pure auto-file. Fast-path preservation: if caption matches 'add this to X:' or 'new topic X:' (trailing ':'), the file body is appended and the deterministic pattern-match branch in routeFreeText fires with ZERO Gemini calls, matching the quota rule in ARCHITECTURE.md §5. Free-form captions are prepended to file content as Gemini context. explicit-path (/add ForceReply) branch is fully deterministic — no Gemini even for unstructured file content, matching how a typed note is treated on the same branch. Router wired both in main path (message.document -> handleDocumentMessage null) and inside pending 'add' flow (message.document -> handleDocumentMessage path). Confirmation feedback follows fix-01 style: ✅ Filed "<file_name>" as entry <id> under <title> (<breadcrumb>). Files: media.js (edit), router.js (edit).
fixes.tested: node --check on both edited files passed. Live end-to-end verification (send .txt with/without caption) deferred to the whole-round VERIFY pass.

fixes.name: Telegram-native home interface + Settings/Keys sub-interface, KV-backed key pool
fixes.notes: Persistent tappable home menu on /start and /menu. Sections: Browse topics, Read a topic (drills to browse->read), Export (Whole notebook / Pick a topic), Settings. Every screen has: title line, buttons for actions, Back button, Home button. Settings sub-menu -> Gemini Keys screen (Add keys / List keys / Clear all / Back / Home). Keys stored in Cloudflare KV namespace CODEX_KV bound in wrangler.toml. Since wrangler v4 will not auto-create KV namespaces from a binding alone, add a step in .github/workflows/deploy.yml (predeploy script) that (a) checks whether the namespace exists via CF API using CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, (b) creates it if missing, (c) writes the id into wrangler.toml before wrangler deploy — idempotent, safe on repeat pushes. Keys pasted newline-separated in one message via ForceReply. Masked list view (last 4 chars, indexed). Tap-to-remove per index + Clear All (with confirmation). Seed migration: on every keypool read, if KV pool is empty and env.GEMINI_API_KEY is set, promote that secret to KV key #1 automatically (so the operator's existing setup keeps working with zero manual re-add). Register bot command menu via setMyCommands on deploy (add small workflow step or inside the Worker on first call) with /start /menu /help. Update /help text to describe the tappable interface as primary.
fixes.concerns: KV namespace auto-provisioning must not require operator dashboard access. Chosen: GH Actions predeploy step. Also update ARCHITECTURE.md §3 to describe CODEX_KV and the key pool model.

fixes.name: Switch to gemini-flash-lite-latest + multi-key rotation with sticky last-successful key
fixes.notes: Change GEMINI_MODEL default to gemini-flash-lite-latest in wrangler.toml AND in gemini.js fallback string. Rewrite gemini() to iterate the key pool (from KV via fix-03), starting from the last-successful key index (stored in KV under key 'gemini:last_ok_idx'). Only rotate on key-specific failures: HTTP 429 (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED), 403 (PERMISSION_DENIED/API_KEY_INVALID), 400 with API_KEY_INVALID in body. Do NOT rotate on 500/503 — retry once on same key then bubble. On success, persist new index. If every key exhausted for this request, surface a specific failure message via the fix-01 feedback style.
